payload.summary: No strict rotation — priority list system. Priority 1: synergy application. Priority 2: Shadowburst spenders (20% meter consumed per cast for increased damage) when meter available. Priority 3: secondary damage skills (Cruel Cutter, Demolition as anchors). Priority 4: meter generators (Intrude skills). Shadow Shards and Shadow Injection referenced as buff mechanics. No Demonize/transformation — full human-form playstyle.
